data.name: Jannah
data.gender_notes: Jannah is used as a female name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ج-ن-ن (j-n-n), 'to cover, conceal'; janna means 'garden, paradise'. Its root is ج-ن-ن (j-n-n). A Qur'anic term for paradise. Jannah is a Arabic name meaning “Paradise; garden”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jannah expresses “Paradise; garden”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ج-ن-ن (j-n-n), 'to cover, conceal'; janna means 'garden, paradise'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jannah total 21, reducing to 3. Number 3 is associated with expression, creativity and optimism.
